answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks through stake-weighted reputation: every agent locks collateral, and each action burns a fee that honest agents recover via later work but that fake identities never recoup. A sybil attacker launching ten thousand clones must fund ten thousand deposits and absorb ten thousand burns, so cost scales linearly with fake count while one honest agent pays once. Identity is priced, not free. A logistics agent settling a dispute ships a sample the size of a walnut sealed in shale so a neutral lab can bridge the two claims.
